name: critical-path
description: Find the tasks that control project duration.

interface.longDescription: Project planning tool for critical path calculations. Provide task durations and finish-to-start dependencies to compute project duration, earliest/latest start and finish offsets, total slack and slack before immediate successors, all critical tasks and connecting edges, and one illustrative longest chain. The interactive widget filters critical tasks and lets you edit a duration; the task schedule downloads as CSV. Multiple parallel critical chains are preserved. Durations use integer thousandth-unit arithmetic. Supports one to forty tasks and at most 160 links. Offsets start at zero; no calendar dates, holidays, resource leveling, lags or deadlines. CSV links expire in about one hour.
defaultPrompt: Calculate critical path: A 3 days; B 5 after A; C 2 after A; D 1 after B and C.
Critical path in hours: B takes 2 after A; A takes 4. Return earliest and latest offsets.
Find parallel critical chains: A 3 days, B 3 days, C 1 day after both A and B.

positive.prompt: Calculate critical path: A 3 days; B 5 after A; C 2 after A; D 1 after B and C.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculates project duration 9 days; critical tasks are A, B, D. Shows earliest/latest offsets, slack and CSV download. The widget can edit a duration and recalculate.

positive.prompt: Critical path in hours: B takes 2 after A; A takes 4. Return earliest and latest offsets.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculates project duration 6 hours; critical tasks are A, B. Shows earliest/latest offsets, slack and CSV download. The widget can edit a duration and recalculate.

positive.prompt: Find parallel critical chains: A 3 days, B 3 days, C 1 day after both A and B.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculates project duration 4 days; critical tasks are A, B, C. Shows earliest/latest offsets, slack and CSV download. The widget can edit a duration and recalculate.

positive.prompt: Critical path: Design 2 days, Launch milestone 0 days after Design.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculates project duration 2 days; critical tasks are Design, Launch. Shows earliest/latest offsets, slack and CSV download. The widget can edit a duration and recalculate.

positive.prompt: Calculate slack in hours: A 0.125; B 0.375 after A; C 0.2 independent.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculates project duration 0.5 hours; critical tasks are A, B. Shows earliest/latest offsets, slack and CSV download. The widget can edit a duration and recalculate.

pl-PL.subtitle: Ścieżka krytyczna projektu
pl-PL.description: Oblicz czas projektu, ścieżkę krytyczną, najwcześniejsze i najpóźniejsze terminy oraz zapas czasu na podstawie zadań i zależności. Zmieniaj czas zadania i pobierz harmonogram CSV. Obsługuje zadania równoległe i kamienie milowe. Nie uwzględnia dat kalendarzowych, zasobów ani opóźnień między zadaniami.

de-DE.subtitle: Kritischer Projektpfad
de-DE.description: Berechnen Sie Projektdauer, kritische Aufgaben, früheste und späteste Zeitpunkte sowie Zeitpuffer aus Dauer und Abhängigkeiten. Ändern Sie eine Dauer und laden Sie den CSV-Plan herunter. Parallele Pfade und Meilensteine werden unterstützt. Kalender, Ressourcen und Zeitabstände werden nicht berücksichtigt.

es-ES.subtitle: Ruta crítica de proyectos
es-ES.description: Calcula la duración del proyecto, las tareas críticas, los tiempos tempranos y tardíos y la holgura a partir de duraciones y dependencias. Cambia una duración y descarga el plan CSV. Admite rutas paralelas e hitos. No considera calendarios, recursos ni desfases.

fr-FR.subtitle: Chemin critique du projet
fr-FR.description: Calculez la durée du projet, les tâches critiques, les dates relatives au plus tôt et au plus tard et les marges à partir des durées et dépendances. Modifiez une durée et téléchargez le planning CSV. Les chemins parallèles et jalons sont pris en charge. Sans calendriers, ressources ni décalages.

ja-JP.subtitle: プロジェクトのクリティカルパス
ja-JP.description: タスクの所要時間と依存関係から、プロジェクト期間、クリティカルなタスク、最早・最遅時刻、余裕時間を計算します。所要時間を変更して再計算し、CSVをダウンロードできます。並列経路とマイルストーンに対応します。カレンダー、リソース制約、ラグは考慮しません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Caminho crítico do projeto
pt-BR.description: Calcule a duração do projeto, tarefas críticas, tempos mais cedo e mais tarde e folgas usando durações e dependências. Altere uma duração e baixe o cronograma CSV. Aceita caminhos paralelos e marcos. Não considera calendários, recursos ou defasagens.
